papers.title: Susceptibility to task-irrelevant auditory distractors in relation to visual working memory in children with and without attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.

papers.title: Impact of hearing loss on visual selective attention: Evidence from N2pc and resting-state networks.

papers.title: Content Validity and Psychometric Properties Assessment of the Virtual Reality Functional Capacity Assessment Tool and Application in Multiregional Clinical Trials of Cognitive Impairment Associated with Schizophrenia
